title: What this is
text: IMAX is a triage workspace for linguists and targeting officers working multi-language intercepted communications. Everything you see is fabricated — every name, number and document. The banner says so on every screen, because a screenshot of this should never be mistaken for intelligence.

title: No verdict without the source
text: Threads open bilingual. English leads, the original stays on screen, and the direction is correct for right-to-left script. There is no toggle, because a toggle invites judging a translation with the source hidden.

title: The verdict travels
text: A correction is written against the source, and the verdict travels with the text into everything downstream. The linguist can also take a verdict back. An assertion made by a mis-click has to be retractable.

title: A bench, not a dashboard
text: This is a bench, not a dashboard. The find tools collapse away entirely, and what remains is the stack of work.

title: Decide where you read
text: Thread decisions are made in the viewer, where the officer has actually read the thread. Flag it to a targeting officer, or discard it. The queue asks only one question: is this worked.

title: Narrow by what is in it
text: Facets narrow the queue by what a thread contains. Selectors, passports, people, geography, documents. Anything flagged for a targeter can be pulled back out, because a handoff you cannot find again is a handoff you have lost.

title: Four languages
text: Search runs across four languages, in native script and across the translation layer, so a linguist can find in Arabic what was written in Arabic.

title: Land on the evidence
text: A hit lands on the evidence itself and flashes it, rather than dropping the analyst at the top of a long thread to hunt for the line they searched for.

title: Length costs nothing
text: The stream is windowed, so thread length costs nothing. Measured against a two thousand message thread, a scroll repaints inside seventeen milliseconds against a two hundred millisecond budget. Order is chronological and reversible, because collection feeds do not arrive in order.

title: Enrich once
text: Enrichment runs once for the whole thread. Translation, entity extraction, and a summary on demand. Against a live model gateway these calls take real seconds, so each one says that it is working.

title: Documents
text: Documents share the same surface. This is a five page customs declaration. Right to left, tabular, stamped and signed.

title: Read the document
text: The viewer opens to full screen, because a scan you cannot read is a scan you cannot exploit. The extracted text sits beneath the page, numbered line by line, and every line carries its own English beside it. The original sits on the side its script starts from, so an Arabic form reads from the right and a Russian one from the left.

title: Page and zoom
text: Page through the manifest. On a tabular form the pairing is the whole point: a line item and its rendering on the same row, rather than a paragraph of gloss you have to map back yourself.

title: Officer marks
text: The officer's own triage marks become a searchable facet back in the queue, and a tag coined on one document is offered on the next. A tag that cannot be applied twice is not a tag.

title: The unit of gold
text: Design work during performance changed what this produces. What was evaluated made clipped fragments. A linguist's product is not a fragment — it is the whole translated, reviewed thread, because the fragment loses the context that makes it mean anything. So only a fully reviewed thread can be promoted. A standing channel runs to thousands of messages and is worked whole, so the remainder can be accepted in one action — recorded as bulk-accepted, never as a line-by-line confirmation, because the transcript must not claim a reading that did not happen.

title: One output
text: The officer's read on the conversation itself — register, authenticity, who these people are to each other — leads the gold copy, above the transcript it is about. Promoted threads are ordered by the officer and exported as full verdicted transcripts: every message with its original, its English, who certified it, and any note attached along the way. This removes behaviour that was evaluated. The original implementation is retained unmodified, and the removal reverts in a single commit if strict parity is preferred.

title: What is proven
text: Six containers: the application, and five single responsibility enrichment services behind frozen contracts, so production cutover is a configuration change one service at a time. Every push rebuilds the images, scans them, deploys them and smokes them. It has also been deployed and run in the target environment, with that evidence held high side. The enrichment services run on fixtures by default and take a live model gateway by configuration; pointing them at the one inside the enclave is the step still ahead, and every pod says at startup which mode it is in.
